source_card_updates.title: Parametric Resynthesis of Measured Spatial Room Impulse Responses

method.preprocessing: HOA encoding, pre-delay removal, estimated mixing-time split
method.early_stage: Herglotz analysis for reflection count and DoA/ToA; frequency-dependent order selection; explicit residual scattering and spatial-aliasing modeling
method.late_stage: frequency-dependent RT60 and initial decay power estimation; FDN/DFDN resynthesis; third-octave covariance matching; directional segmentation
method.evaluation: spherical correlation in 5.3-ms blocks and binaurally encoded EDR-difference maps against measurement

source_specific_numbers_not_project_pres.origin: paper method and reported evaluation configuration

supported_conclusions: Early reflections and late reverberation require distinct models after an estimated mixing-time boundary.
Matching frequency-dependent decay and initial late-field power is not sufficient to reconstruct measured spatial covariance; the authors impose covariance per third-octave band.
Finite array order, scattering and spatial aliasing are part of the measured SMA domain and affect reconstruction.
The reported objective comparison improves spherical correlation and EDR agreement against a direct-resynthesis baseline.
limitations: The paper reports figures rather than a tabulated multi-room statistical evaluation or effect sizes.
The paper contains no controlled listening test; formal perceptual validation is explicitly future work.
Evaluation details shown in the paper are for one EM32 measurement in the IRCAM Espro hall, using five 32-delay-line DFDNs.
The late model assumes one exponential decay slope per directional frequency band and does not handle coupled-room multi-slope decay.
Finite SMA order prevents recovery of every reflection, and adjacent-beam overlap can overestimate energy.
Intrinsic spatial resolution of the measurement is not increased by resynthesis.
No CPU, platform, real-time factor or end-to-end latency benchmark is reported.
No source-code repository is linked by the paper or companion page.
The method is HOA/SMA immersive-audio work, not a validation on conventional stereo rock mixes or drum-room microphones.
companion_page_findings: The official page exposes binaural dry/measurement/direct-resynthesis/proposed-method examples across seven room/configuration sections and three dry source types; this is a demonstration set, not a listener study.
The authors state that multi-slope decay in the Chaillot example creates larger EDR error that was not highly perceptible in their informal listening.
The authors state that missed salient early reflections in the Athenee example are audibly perceptible in the drum example.
No audio files were downloaded and no project DSP metrics were calculated.

knowledge_cards.title: Mixing time is a model boundary, not a creative pre-delay value
knowledge_cards.claim: In the reviewed SRIR framework the direct/early field and stochastic late field are separated at an estimated mixing time after removal of acquisition pre-delay; shifting a complete reverb return is not equivalent.

knowledge_cards.title: Early reflections require event-level spatial and spectral representation
knowledge_cards.claim: Early-reflection reconstruction uses reflection count, DoA, ToA and extracted spectrum; a global RT60 or average EQ does not represent that structure.

knowledge_cards.title: Late decay has separable spectral, energy and spatial statistics
knowledge_cards.claim: The framework estimates RT60(f), initial decay power P0(f) and bandwise spatial covariance separately; none of the three is a complete late-reverberation descriptor.

knowledge_cards.title: Covariance matching is not perceptual equivalence
knowledge_cards.claim: Imposing measured second-order covariance can improve spatial-correlation metrics, but the paper does not establish listener preference or transparency.

knowledge_cards.title: Single-slope decay is a falsifiable assumption
knowledge_cards.claim: A single exponential slope per directional band is unsuitable when the measured room exhibits coupled or multi-slope decay; the companion Chaillot example exposes this failure.

knowledge_cards.title: Missed early reflections may matter more than a large decay-map error
knowledge_cards.claim: The companion notes report an audible drum difference from omitted salient early reflections, while a larger multi-slope EDR error was described as less perceptible; metric magnitude and audibility are not interchangeable.

knowledge_cards.title: Measurement-artifact matching is domain-specific
knowledge_cards.claim: Rigid-sphere scattering and spatial aliasing must be modeled when reproducing a particular SMA measurement, but they are not desirable generic coloration targets for a stereo rock reverb.

knowledge_cards.title: Real-time suitability requires a measured compute contract
knowledge_cards.claim: The paper proposes a computationally efficient real-time architecture but provides no platform, real-time factor, CPU load or end-to-end latency table; deployment claims remain unverified for this project.

rule_candidates.title: Separate early and late reverb decisions
rule_candidates.when_to_apply: Designing or matching a rock room, snare space or ambience return.
rule_candidates.what_to_change: Treat early-reflection pattern and late-tail decay as separate controllable factors after estimating a physically or perceptually defensible boundary.
rule_candidates.how_to_verify: One-factor renders with the other stage fixed, matched wet contribution and full-mix blind listening.
rule_candidates.cancel_when: The split creates a discontinuity, timing smear or no repeatable benefit over measured/unchanged ambience.

rule_candidates.title: Do not infer a room match from RT60 alone
rule_candidates.when_to_apply: Comparing measured ambience with an algorithmic late tail.
rule_candidates.what_to_change: Report frequency-dependent decay, initial late-field energy and channel/spatial relation separately.
rule_candidates.how_to_verify: EDR/decay analysis, bandwise channel relation, mono check and blind full-mix preference.
rule_candidates.cancel_when: A metric improves while the tail becomes tonally wrong, unstable or less preferred.

rule_candidates.title: Gate single-slope late-tail models
rule_candidates.when_to_apply: A measured or desired decay has one stable slope within each relevant band.
rule_candidates.what_to_change: Allow a single-slope FDN candidate only after checking for multi-slope or coupled-room behavior.
rule_candidates.how_to_verify: Inspect decay curves by band and compare single-slope with measured-tail and multi-slope-capable baselines.
rule_candidates.cancel_when: Systematic curvature, slope changes or audible late-tail mismatch remain.

rule_candidates.title: Keep SMA compensation tied to its measurement chain
rule_candidates.when_to_apply: Resynthesizing a known spherical-array measurement with known geometry and encoding.
rule_candidates.what_to_change: Model scattering and aliasing only for the matching array/order/encoding contract; do not transfer those artifacts as generic reverb coloration.
rule_candidates.how_to_verify: Array-specific impulse/spherical-response comparison and a control without artifact emulation.
rule_candidates.cancel_when: Array geometry or encoding metadata are missing, or the target is an ordinary stereo ambience rather than SMA reconstruction.

rule_candidates.title: Separate objective spatial fit from preference
rule_candidates.when_to_apply: Evaluating a reverb or room-resynthesis candidate with EDR, correlation or covariance objectives.
rule_candidates.what_to_change: Store objective fit, audible artifacts and Dmitry's blind preference as independent outcomes.
rule_candidates.how_to_verify: Randomized loudness-matched A/B in solo and full mix, plus declared measurement settings.
rule_candidates.cancel_when: Only the optimized metric improves or the result is preferred only when louder.

rule_candidates.title: Stress-test salient early-reflection omissions on drums
rule_candidates.when_to_apply: A parametric early-reflection detector or sparse-room model is used on percussive rock material.
rule_candidates.what_to_change: Compare the reconstructed early field against measured/unchanged early response using kick, snare and cymbal transients before accepting it.
rule_candidates.how_to_verify: Transient-specific null/energy inspection and blind full-kit/full-mix listening.
rule_candidates.cancel_when: Salient reflections are omitted, duplicated or cause audible pre/post-transient coloration.

rule_candidates.title: Require compute and rights contracts before dataset use
rule_candidates.when_to_apply: Considering SRIR resynthesis for bulk dataset generation or runtime deployment.
rule_candidates.what_to_change: Record source-audio/IR rights, code/version, hardware, real-time factor, latency and failure coverage before use.
rule_candidates.how_to_verify: Traceable licence record and measured local benchmark on free/open code and project-owned or explicitly licensed material.
rule_candidates.cancel_when: Audio rights, implementation source or deployment measurements are unresolved.

experiment_plans.title: Late-tail topology with fixed measured early field
experiment_plans.material: project-owned or explicitly licensed dense-rock drums/full mix plus a project-owned or explicitly licensed room impulse
controls: matched wet loudness and initial late energy
experiment_plans.success: The lowest-complexity model preserves the desired decay and space while matching or beating the measured-tail baseline in Dmitry's blind full-mix judgment.
experiment_plans.cancel: A slope mismatch, tail discontinuity, image change or loudness advantage explains the result.

experiment_plans.title: Early-reflection representation with fixed late tail
experiment_plans.cancel: The sparse model misses or duplicates a salient reflection or is not preferred to measured early response.

experiment_plans.title: Late-field covariance treatment
experiment_plans.cancel: Metric matching narrows, destabilizes or phase-colors the musical image.

experiment_plans.title: Objective-fit versus audibility disagreement audit
experiment_plans.single_factor: controlled early-reflection omission or late-decay mismatch
experiment_plans.cancel: The defect cannot be isolated or level matching is inadequate.

revised_conclusions.before: The abstract-level card reported matching spatial correlation and EDR but left perceptual evidence, failure cases and computation unknown.
revised_conclusions.after: Full review confirms objective improvements against direct resynthesis, but no controlled listening test or compute benchmark. The companion page exposes multi-slope and missed-early-reflection failures through author observations, not formal listener statistics.

revised_conclusions.before: The source was potentially relevant to drum-room and spatial processing.
revised_conclusions.after: Only the early/late decomposition, decay/statistics separation and evaluation discipline transfer as hypotheses. SMA artifact emulation, HOA rendering parameters and reported numeric settings are not stereo-rock presets.

novelty.summary: The priority DAFx-26 source advanced from abstract-only to full-text review. The useful project result is primarily a tighter boundary: early/late decomposition and separate decay/energy/covariance evaluation are supported; perceptual superiority, stereo-rock transfer and real-time deployment are not yet demonstrated.

safety: All rules remain candidate with auto_apply:false.
No audio, DSP engine, repository code, runtime configuration or active rule changed.
No companion or commercial audio was downloaded, extracted or uploaded.
No numeric DSP metrics were invented; method numbers are labeled as source-specific.
No paid subscription, GPU job or arbitrary third-party Space was used.
handoff: Separate early reflections from the late field, but do not treat the split as a creative pre-delay preset. RT60, initial late energy and spatial/channel covariance are independent descriptors. Match objective room metrics and musical preference separately; reject single-slope tails on multi-slope rooms and keep SMA artifact compensation tied to the original array domain.
